description: Bridge an F Prime/CCSDS connection over any transport by spawning 'socat <address> STDIO'. Supports serial, TLS, UDP, SSH, PTY and more.

name.description: Name of the FSW once a connection is made

address.title: Socat Address
address.description: socat far-side address spec (the near side is always STDIO). Examples: '/dev/ttyUSB0,b115200,raw', 'OPENSSL:fsw:5000,verify=0', 'TCP:192.168.1.9:50000'

dictionary.description: FPrime dictionary to send/receive data with
